lesson.title: Appearance, Colors & Comparisons
lesson.subtitle: Height, size, age, colors, cleanliness, and comparisons
lesson.description: Describe physical appearance, size, colors, cleanliness, quietness, and compare similarities or differences.

learning_objectives: Describe appearance and physical properties: 矮, 短, 胖, 瘦, 老, 年轻, 旧, 大小, 干净, 脏, 蓝, and 黄色.
Describe quietness and degree: 安静, 比较, and 更.
Compare things using 一样, 不同, and 差不多.

metadata.audience: HSK 3.0 Level 3 learners with Level 1-2 foundations

overview.topic_description: Observable properties, colors, and comparison words.
overview.focus: Use 跟 / 和……一样 for "the same as" and 差不多 for "almost / about the same".

questions.prompt: Who likes coming to the new reading room after class?
questions.answer: Both young students and older teachers.
questions.explanation: The passage says 不管年轻的学生还是老教师，都喜欢来这里看书.

questions.prompt: Write two sentences comparing two things using 一样 or 不同 and 更.
questions.answer: 这两件衣服的样式差不多，但蓝色的那件更干净好看。
questions.explanation: Use 差不多/一样/不同 with 更.

questions.prompt: Which phrase means "almost / roughly the same"?
questions.explanation: 差不多 means almost or approximately the same.

dialogue.title: Comparing Old and New Apartments
dialogue.context_en: Two friends compare their old dorm room with a newly rented room.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 你新租的房间和以前那个大小差不多吗？
turns.pinyin: Nǐ xīn zū de fángjiān hé yǐqián nàge dàxiǎo chàbuduō ma?
turns.english: Is the size of your newly rented room about the same as the old one?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 大小差不多，不过新房间更干净，也更安静。
turns.pinyin: Dàxiǎo chàbuduō, búguò xīn fángjiān gèng gānjìng, yě gèng ānjìng.
turns.english: About the same size, though the new room is cleaner and quieter.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 墙是什么颜色的？还是蓝的吗？
turns.pinyin: Qiáng shì shénme yánsè de? Háishi lán de ma?
turns.english: What color are the walls? Still blue?

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 这次不同了，是淡黄色的，看起来比较亮堂。
turns.pinyin: Zhè cì bù tóng le, shì dàn huángsè de, kàn qǐlái bǐjiào liàngtang.
turns.english: It’s different this time—light yellow, so it looks fairly bright.

patterns.title: Comparing sameness with 跟 / 和……一样
patterns.explanation_en: Use A + 跟 / 和 + B + 一样 (+ adj) to say two things are the same; negate with 不一样.

examples.hanzi: 这双鞋的颜色和那双不一样。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shuāng xié de yánsè hé nà shuāng bù yíyàng.
examples.english: The color of this pair of shoes is not the same as that pair.

examples.hanzi: 弟弟现在长得和哥哥一样高了。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi xiànzài zhǎng de hé gēge yíyàng gāo le.
examples.english: The younger brother has now grown as tall as his older brother.

patterns.title: Intensifying with 比较 and 更
patterns.explanation_en: 比较 (bǐjiào) means "fairly / relatively"; 更 (gèng) means "even more" (often in comparisons).

examples.hanzi: 她比去年瘦了一点儿，看起来更年轻了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǐ qùnián shòu le yìdiǎnr, kàn qǐlái gèng niánqīng le.
examples.english: She is a bit slimmer than last year and looks even younger.

examples.hanzi: 这件旧外套比较短，换那件长的吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn jiù wàitào bǐjiào duǎn, huàn nà jiàn cháng de ba.
examples.english: This old jacket is relatively short—switch to that long one.

guided_building.instruction_en: Describe physical traits, cleanliness, and colors.

model.english: That little dog is a bit chubby, and its legs are short too.

model_answer.pinyin: Nà kē shù bù gāo, bǐjiào ǎi.
model_answer.english: That tree isn’t tall—it’s fairly short.

model_answer.hanzi: 这本旧书和新版有很多不同。

model_answer.english: This old book has many differences from the new edition.

reading.title: A Clean and Quiet Reading Room

paragraphs.hanzi: 学校新开了一间阅览室，里面非常安静，桌子和地板总是擦得很干净。墙上挂着几幅蓝天和黄色花朵的画。
paragraphs.pinyin: Xuéxiào xīn kāi le yì jiān yuèlǎnshì, lǐmiàn fēicháng ānjìng, zhuōzi hé dìbǎn zǒngshì cā de hěn gānjìng. Qiángshàng guà zhe jǐ fú lántiān hé huángsè huāduǒ de huà.
paragraphs.english: The school newly opened a reading room; inside it is very quiet, and the tables and floor are always wiped clean. Paintings of blue skies and yellow flowers hang on the wall.

paragraphs.hanzi: 每天下课以后，不管年轻的学生还是老教师，都喜欢来这里看书。大家觉得这里比宿舍更适合专心学习。
paragraphs.pinyin: Měitiān xiàkè yǐhòu, bùguǎn niánqīng de xuéshēng háishi lǎo jiàoshī, dōu xǐhuan lái zhèlǐ kànshū. Dàjiā juéde zhèlǐ bǐ sùshè gèng shìhé zhuānxīn xuéxí.
paragraphs.english: Every day after class, both young students and older teachers like coming here to read. Everyone feels it is even more suitable for focused study than the dorm.

questions.prompt_en: What paintings hang on the wall of the reading room?
questions.answer_en: Paintings of blue skies and yellow flowers.

questions.prompt_en: Why do people prefer studying there over the dorm?
questions.answer_en: Because it is quieter, clean, and better suited for focused study.

speaking_tasks.scenario_en: Compare two seasons, rooms, or cities using 一样, 不同, or 更.

model_answer.hanzi: 上海和北京不一样，上海冬天更暖和，不过两个城市都很热闹。
model_answer.pinyin: Shànghǎi hé Běijīng bù yíyàng, Shànghǎi dōngtiān gèng nuǎnhuo, búguò liǎng ge chéngshì dōu hěn rènào.
model_answer.english: Shanghai and Beijing are not the same; Shanghai is warmer in winter, though both cities are lively.

speaking_tasks.scenario_en: Describe a room or object using 干净, 大小, and a color.

model_answer.hanzi: 我的房间大小刚刚好，被子是蓝色的，每天都收拾得很干净。
model_answer.pinyin: Wǒ de fángjiān dàxiǎo gānggāng hǎo, bèizi shì lán sè de, měitiān dōu shōushi de hěn gānjìng.
model_answer.english: My room is just the right size, my quilt is blue, and I tidy it clean every day.

teaching_plan.common_pitfall: 矮 (ǎi) is for height of people/trees/buildings; 短 (duǎn) is for length of objects, hair, or time. Never say *短人 for a short person.
teaching_plan.pronunciation_focus: 安静 (ānjìng) moves from flat ān to falling jìng; 差不多 (chàbuduō) has fourth + neutral + first.
